name: Chen's Empty Keg
label: Quest
description: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn hopes to revive Chen Stormstout's potent brew with wild ingredients from the Barrens.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn hopes to revive Chen Stormstout's potent brew with wild ingredients from the Barrens.

A marked keg brings Chen Stormstout to mind for Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet. Chen passed the secrets of his namesake brew to Drohn's mentor, who entrusted them to Drohn. The recipe calls for raw, potent elements taken straight from the Barrens' fierce wildlife, an unusual choice to those outside the brewing trade.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Would you like a taste of Chen's namesake? Ahh, the stormstout is a mighty brew. Chen taught the recipe to my mentor, and my mentor passed it on to me. I'll need you to get me a few things, but I can tell you this: the kick is worth it.
Bring me 5 savannah lion tusks from any savannah lion, 5 plainstrider kidneys from any plainstrider, and 1 thunder lizard horn from any species of thunder lizard. That should do the trick nicely.
You can find these ingredients throughout the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha... I never thought I'd make more of this stuff ever again.
You've stirred in me a great sense of nostalgia, friend. Kind of reminds me of the last time I made a batch of trogg brew. Thank you. The memories warm my stomach.
